goal.objective: Build an automated factory that continuously produces at least one automation-science-pack per game minute from natural resources.

definition.summary: Build an automated factory that continuously produces at least one automation-science-pack per game minute from natural resources.

nodes.why_it_matters: Produce 10 copper plates from natural ore using the held furnace. Exit with electronics researched and at least 10 copper plates held. This is a finite bootstrap, not the final automated copper supply.

Use natural iron ore to complete the exact 50-iron-plate production trigger and verify steam-power research. Prefer reusing the held drill and furnace for direct feeding after comparing relocation and setup costs.
After electronics and steam-power are researched, craft one lab to complete the exact automation-science-pack technology trigger. Exit with that technology researched and a lab available.

Provide shared power for research and assembly. Exit with connected water, boiler and engine infrastructure supplying a real electrical load; separate installation boundaries when fresh port geometry or identities are needed.
Produce the initial science after its recipe unlock and supply a powered lab. Exit with automation researched before any assembling-machine-1 construction.

Establish coal extraction and automatic replenishment for fuel extraction, smelters and the boiler. Exit with the fuel routes operating without hand transfers and with a validated positive fuel balance.
assumptions: Choose equipment only after checking its live recipe availability; add any required unlocks before construction.
Size extraction and transport from the selected consumers' live demand.

nodes.why_it_matters: Establish automatically fueled natural-resource mining, smelting and plate delivery sufficient for the selected science rate. Bootstrap stock does not substitute for this production route.
Establish automatically fueled copper mining, smelting and plate delivery sufficient for the selected science rate, independently of the finite electronics bootstrap.
Provide powered assembly supplied by the automatic iron route. Exit with automatic gear delivery sufficient for science, using live recipe sizing and verified transport capacity.

Connect automatic copper and gear inputs to powered science assembly and an unblocked output. Verify at least one automation-science-pack per minute over a full clean window with no hand-fed ingredient dependency.

steps.description: Acquire 10 coal for bootstrap furnace fuel and a reusable fuel reserve.

execution_guidance.approach: Gather the 10-coal inventory deficit from a natural resource patch; retain unused fuel for later bootstrap work.
execution_guidance.rationale: A finite fuel batch starts the held furnace without building a coal production chain before its consumers are known. Automatic replenishment remains a separate required milestone.
constraints: Target 10 coal held, not an unconditional gain of 10.
Do not consume the held iron plates or drill.
Use native resource collection rather than guessed rock yields.

steps.description: Acquire 10 copper ore for the electronics production trigger.

execution_guidance.approach: Gather the deficit to 10 copper ore, selecting the temporary furnace work area after reaching the patch.
execution_guidance.rationale: Only 10 ore is needed for this trigger. Hand collection avoids installing and later recovering a drill at a temporary copper site; dedicated direct feeding is reserved for repeated production demand.
constraints: Keep the held burner drill available for subsequent iron work.
No assembling-machine construction before automation research.

steps.description: Place the held stone furnace near the copper work area; obtain its fresh identity before supplying it.

execution_guidance.approach: Place the one held stone furnace near the selected copper work area, then observe its exact identity and inventory.
execution_guidance.rationale: Reusing the held furnace avoids another construction bill. End at placement because exact supply and output monitoring require a newly observed placed identity.
constraints: Use the held furnace rather than crafting a duplicate.
Placement proves presence only, not working production.
Read the placed identity before exact supply.

steps.description: Smelt and collect 10 copper plates using the acquired ore and coal, then verify electronics is researched.

execution_guidance.approach: Confirm copper smelting and fuel requirements, supply the exact furnace, produce and collect 10 copper plates, and verify electronics research.
execution_guidance.rationale: The native trigger requires actual copper-plate production, not a research request. Bind an output checkpoint while smelting, then verify both 10 held plates and electronics researched before closing the step.
constraints: Use the observed furnace identity; do not substitute another.
Use all 10 ore for the trigger and coal only as required.
Do not treat this hand-fed bootstrap as automated throughput.
